findings.fix: Move the paragraph outside the form, or remove it and display it with JavaScript after submission.

findings.fix: Add `name="preferred_shipping_speed"` (or the appropriate field name) to the select element.
findings.violation: The select element is missing a `name` attribute, so its value will not be submitted with the form.

findings.evidence: "Full name" field with `name="full_name"` and separate "First name"/"Last name" fields with `name="given_name"` and `name="family_name"`, both marked required
findings.fix: Remove either the "Full name" field or the split "First name"/"Last name" fields, keeping only one naming approach.
findings.violation: The form collects the user's name twice in different formats, which is redundant and will confuse users about which fields to fill.

findings.evidence: `placeholder="Must be 8 digits"` with no pattern, maxlength, or minlength validation
findings.fix: Add `pattern="\d{8}"` and `maxlength="8"` to enforce the 8-digit requirement.
findings.violation: The placeholder specifies an 8-digit requirement, but there is no actual validation enforcing this constraint.
